body: The pasted form has many tempting shapes: order 999999999, placeholder IBAN DE00 0000 0000 0000 0000 00, example email nobody@example.invalid, and reserved address 198.51.100.8. The generated labels are {{Email}}, {{custom:iban}}, {{custom:ip_address}}, {{custom:credit_card}}, and {{custom:eth_address}}. This fixture keeps unlabeled bait near real generated spans to stress false-positive handling.
